page.layout: One scan showing only the outside of a book cover: a speckled yellow-brown paper binding with black spots, no printed text. No printed page, no column, no margin text.
page.notes: The scan shows the marbled or sprinkled paper cover of a book, with dark spots distributed over the whole surface. No printed words, headings, page numbers or notes are visible. The dark background at the edges is the scanner bed, not printed matter.
